Metadata.title: Klik Go — Delivered to your door, wherever you are
Metadata.description: Food and essentials from your neighborhood stores, delivered by riders from your barangay.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data Klik Go collects when you order, deliver or sell through the app, why we use it, who sees it and the rights you have under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Klik Go runs the ordering, delivery and payment service in this app and is the personal information controller for the data described here. Contact our Data Protection Officer at the privacy contact listed below.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Your name and mobile number (to sign in and reach you about an order); delivery addresses and the map pin; your orders, payments and ratings; for riders, ID documents, vehicle details, live location while on duty and payout details; for stores, business and payout details; the device and browser details needed to keep your account secure.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body: To take and deliver your order, process payment and refunds, prevent fraud and abuse of promos, support you when something goes wrong, keep the records the law requires, and improve the service using counts that do not identify you.

sections.heading: Who sees it
sections.body: The store preparing your order sees the items and your first name; the rider delivering it sees your name, drop-off pin, landmark and a way to call you, only while the order is active. We use service providers that process data for us under contract: hosting and database (Supabase, Vercel), payments (PayMongo), text messages (Semaphore), maps (Google Maps), and error and usage reports (Sentry, PostHog) which receive no names, phone numbers or addresses. We never sell your data and never send your personal data to an AI model.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Orders, payments and payouts: 10 years, as tax law requires. Rider ID documents: deleted 90 days after a rejected application, or 1 year after a rider stops riding. Rider location history: deleted with the account. Everything else: until you delete your account.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may see and download your data (Account → Download my data), correct it, object to its use, and delete your account (Account → Delete my account). When you delete your account we erase your name, number, saved addresses and location history, and remove the address from past orders; the amounts stay, because the law requires us to keep financial records. You may also complain to the National Privacy Commission.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: Data is encrypted in transit, each person can only reach their own records, staff use two-factor sign-in, rider ID files are private and every view is logged.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Data Protection Officer: [privacy contact email to be set before launch].

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use Klik Go to order, deliver or sell. By creating an account you agree to them.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You sign in with your own mobile number and keep your sign-in codes to yourself. One account per person. You must be at least 18, or order with a parent's or guardian's permission.

sections.heading: Orders and prices
sections.body: Stores set their menu prices. Klik Go adds the delivery fee and any small-order or service fee shown before you place the order. The total you confirm at checkout is the total you pay.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: You pay online (GCash, Maya, card or QR Ph) or in cash on delivery. If online payment is paused, cash on delivery stays available.

sections.heading: Cancellations and refunds
sections.body: You can cancel until the store accepts your order. If a store rejects or cannot complete an order, or the delivery fails through no fault of yours, you get a full refund to how you paid.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Riders deliver to the pin and landmark you give. For larger orders the rider asks for a 4-digit PIN shown only to you.

sections.heading: Promos and rewards
sections.body: Promos and referral rewards follow the rules shown with them, one per person and device. We may cancel rewards gained by abuse.

sections.heading: Fair use
sections.body: Do not misuse the app, harass riders or store staff, or try to get around security or limits.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Stores are responsible for their food and products. Klik Go is responsible for the ordering, payment and delivery service, to the extent the law allows.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If we change these terms we will ask you to agree again before you continue.
